 Vacuum pumps - steam ejector MAJ 60/70 AN-MAJ 
 60/70 BN
 Siemens - korting & robuschi, germany

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Galal Mohamed , tested by eng. 
 Khaled Ahmed Elsaid, accepted by eng. Ahmed AbdEl Rahman Ali 
 general director, revised by Mostafa Mohamed Mostafa , approved by eng. 
 Mahmoud Elnakeeb: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS.

This document certified by eng. Seleman Zaki Seleman: EDEPC inspection and quality 
 control general director & MPIS coordinator, and approved by eng. Naser 
 Mohamed

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves of heatexchnger
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main Crane, Alfa Laval,

Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, 
 Cleaning Fluid,
Dial Indicator, Vibrometer.

Measure vibrations 
 level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and 
 determine what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and 
 re-packing (if it is needed).
Check flanges for leakage.

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).
